proposal.hypothesis: For n > 32768, having each 128-thread CTA consume 1024 inputs should reduce the 4M case's first-stage partials from 32768 to 4096 while retaining the existing shared-memory CTA reduction. A second CTA can reduce those partials and write directly to out, replacing four reduction launches plus a copy with two launches. The small-input schedule remains unchanged; total-run performance and full-domain correctness remain for controller evaluation.

retained: Add a large-input first-stage kernel that processes eight elements per thread (1024 per CTA) while retaining the existing 128-thread shared-memory reduction structure.
Reduce first-stage partials in one final CTA and write directly to out, avoiding intermediate reduction launches and a separate copy for n > 32768.
Keep the existing multi-stage path unchanged for n <= 32768.
